amendment_reason: v2 disclosed a lookback-window sensitivity: 3yr z-score reads 2025-2026 10Y as near-average, but it is a genuine ~19yr high. v3 changes only the lookback (756->5040 sessions), same score formula, same 6 episodes, same machinery -- tests the multi-decade-extreme reading of the same hypothesis directly.
canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; recursively sorted keys; separators comma and colon; ensure_ascii=false; trailing newline excluded

data.fingerprint_method: SHA-256 incremental ORDER BY symbol,date; symbol UTF-8 + NUL + date ASCII + NUL + big-endian IEEE-754 close double
data.fingerprint_pending_reason: specification locked before execution; fingerprint recorded fresh at execution time

score.zscore_definition: z_s(t) = (y_s(t) - trailing_mean(y_s, 756)) / trailing_std(y_s, 756), strictly trailing (excludes t)
score.rationale: 20yr trailing lookback -- tests whether todays yield is extreme against a multi-decade reference period, not a 3yr one; see protocol section on structural asymmetry expected from the secular 1981-2020 rate decline

episodes_source: NY Fed operating-policy record and contemporaneous reporting for actual operation start dates, verified live 2026-08-20 -- not derived from DGS2/DGS10 or from TREAST-based mechanical detection (tried and rejected, see protocol section 2)

estimand.per_episode_statistic: max(score(t)) over the 60 sessions immediately before the episode start date (excluding the start date itself)

inference.method: placebo-in-time randomization, not block-bootstrap -- see docs/thesis-track-small-n.md
inference.exclusion_rule: placebo windows may not overlap [episode_start_index - 60, episode_end_index + 60] for any real episode; RMP_2025 has no end date and is treated as extending through the last available session
inference.p_value_convention: one-sided; fraction of resamples with synthetic mean statistic >= observed mean, plus add-one correction

power_precommitment.commitment: a null or inconclusive result is not_evaluable/insufficient evidence, never reframed as rejection

scope_exclusions.no_costs: out of scope for this evidence-layer study
scope_exclusions.no_stage_9b_authorization: this protocol produces Thesis Track evidence-layer output only, not a Stage 9B trade-eligibility decision
scope_exclusions.no_sleeve_or_executable_expression: a real trading expression, if this clears evidence review, is separate, later, separately-locked work
